summary: FatPipe, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC, allowing the company to sell up to $10M of common stock from time to time. This is a routine shelf takedown arrangement, not a special situation. The agent receives a 3% commission. No transaction price, premium, or change of control is involved; it is merely a capital-raising mechanism. There is no board recommendation or advisory role. The filing is an ordinary current report and does not fall into any special-situation category.
